name: Ponte Button Midi Dress
keeps: Vertical centre-front covered button placket (CS Paula)

description: An Autumn-ready black midi dress in structured Ponte jersey, detailed with a clean V-neck, long sleeves, and front covered buttons.

design_details.silhouette_and_fit: Fitted through the bodice and natural waist, releasing into a gently flared A-line midi skirt.
design_details.length_and_proportions: Midi length finishing roughly 15 cm below the knee (115 cm back length for size 36). Balanced with full-length slim sleeves.
design_details.waist_neckline_and_closures: An 18 cm deep V-neckline with self-facing. Fastened down the centre front by ten functional covered buttons ending at mid-thigh.
design_details.fabric_and_weight: Medium-weight 290 gsm compact Ponte Roma knit (viscose/polyester/elastane blend) offering thermal comfort and shape retention.
design_details.texture_and_surface: Dense, ultra-smooth double-knit jersey with two-way stretch and a low-sheen, uniform surface.
design_details.construction_and_seams: Fitted bust darts, set-in sleeves, horizontal waistline seam, and reinforced overlocked internal construction.
design_details.details_and_trims: Ten 14 mm self-fabric dome buttons placed at 4.5 cm intervals along the centre front.
design_details.hem_and_finishing: Blind-stitched 2.5 cm turned hemline at the skirt and twin-needle 2 cm sleeve cuffs. Unlined finish.
design_details.colour_and_finish: Solid deep black (Pantone 19-4008 TCX) with an opaque, light-absorbing matte finish.

visual_description: A solid jet-black long-sleeved midi dress laid completely flat. At the top, the garment features an open, clean-finished V-neckline leading directly into a tailored central front placket. The placket runs vertically down the bodice and into the skirt, secured with a row of ten self-fabric covered dome buttons. The dress is constructed with narrow set-in shoulders and full-length, straight sleeves that finish with clean 2 cm folded cuffs. A clear horizontal seam defines the natural waistline, separating the fitted upper bodice from the lower section. Below the waist seam, the skirt transitions into a gently flared A-line silhouette, cut with fluid drape that falls smoothly to a calf-length midi hem. The hemline is straight across the front and back, finished with a subtle blind stitch. The double-knit Ponte fabric presents a flat, smooth, and matte deep-black surface with clean seam lines throughout. The entire garment is unlined, showcasing crisp edge finishes and a classic, structured high-street design.

prompt:
You are a senior fashion designer at a high-street retailer, designing a new product for the Autumn 2020 collection.

STYLE TO DESIGN FOR: Ladieswear · Dress · Solid · Black · Dark tone

The attached photos are this style's best-selling articles, in this order:
1. Romeo dress: Knee-length, V-neck dress in jersey with short sleeves, a sewn-in wrapover at the top and decorative ties at one side. Unlined.
2. Amalia: Short, straight-cut T-shirt dress in sturdy cotton jersey with a round, rib-trimmed neckline. Unlined.
3. Nora dress(1): Short, straight-style T-shirt dress in soft jersey made from a cotton blend with a round, slightly wider neckline. Short sleeves with sewn-in turn-ups, and short slits in the sides. Unlined.
4. CS Paula dress: Short, V-neck dress in cotton jersey with covered buttons down the front and short puff sleeves with narrow elastication at the hems. Seam at the waist and a gently flared skirt. Unlined.
5. Sorrel: Short, straight-cut dress in woven fabric with a small stand-up collar and V-neck opening at the top. Dropped shoulders, short sleeves with sewn-in turn-ups, and a rounded hem. Slightly longer at the back. Unlined.

Study every photo and description closely: silhouette, length, fit, waistband or neckline, closures, seams, fabric,
texture, weight and drape, hems and finishing details. Identify the visual ideas they share.

Then design ONE new dress for Autumn 2020:
- Stay within the style: Ladieswear, dress, solid, black, dark tone.
- KEEP the strongest visual ideas the best sellers share.
- CHANGE something meaningful for Autumn 2020 (silhouette, length, construction details, fabric or texture), so it
  is a genuinely new product and not a copy of any best seller.
- Keep it realistic to produce at high-street prices.

Be very specific and concrete: a pattern maker must be able to draw it, and an image generator must be able to render it
exactly. Use measurable or visual terms (e.g. "hem 8 cm below the knee", "5 cm wide rib-knit waistband"), not vague ones.

Answer as JSON with exactly these keys:
"name": 2-4 word product name,
"keeps": list of 2-4 visual ideas taken from the best sellers, each saying which best seller(s) it comes from,
"changes": list of 2-4 design changes for Autumn 2020, each saying why it suits the season,
"description": one sentence for a merchandiser,
"design_details": object with these keys, each 1-3 detailed sentences:
    "silhouette_and_fit", "length_and_proportions", "waist_neckline_and_closures", "fabric_and_weight",
    "texture_and_surface", "construction_and_seams", "details_and_trims", "hem_and_finishing", "colour_and_finish",
"visual_description": a 150-250 word paragraph describing exactly what the garment looks like, from top to bottom,
"image_prompt": a 60-110 word prompt for a text-to-image model that describes the garment's look precisely (start with
    the colour and garment type, name every visible detail) and ends with: "flat lay e-commerce catalogue photograph of the single garment, photographed from directly above, on a plain light grey background, soft even studio lighting, sharp fabric detail, no person, no model, no mannequin, no other items, no text, no logo".
